user.title: Connect Meteonomiqs
user.description: Automatically read API keys from /config/secrets.yaml: my_weather_api_1 through my_weather_api_4. One key is sufficient; missing slots are skipped. Alternatively enter direct API keys.

error.required: At least one API key is required.
error.invalid_secrets: The secrets.yaml file contains an invalid API key or cannot be read.

init.title: Automatic weather updates
init.description: Select up to four full hours (HH:00). Fetch five minutes before each hour and publish at the hour. Empty fields disable a slot. API keys are read automatically from secrets.yaml.

error.invalid_time: Enter a full hour in HH:00 format.
